family: DLL sideloading into a copied msedge.exe
notes: Copied Microsoft-signed msedge.exe in ProgramData loads a rogue msedge_elf.dll (the Vidar/Lumma 2025-2026 pattern ST-15 targets), then steals.
known_gap: ST-15 fires, but the copied msedge.exe is still a trusted browser for ST-01 / ST-02 / ST-04
